title: Robot and simulator flagships
description: Curated decisions for flagship robot drivers, vendor SDKs, flight stacks and the simulation suites per-repo work builds on. Several correct a catalogue role that pushed a real driver to tier D (FIT-ROS-04, REGQ-08).
